native_mechanisms: Chain every mark through one impure accumulator, each result seeding the next pull, so the whole buffer passes as a single unbroken pour with no mark judged alone or twice.
Carry the accumulator's final value through seven successive bendings, each discarding half of what it received and passing on only the differing bits.
Validate by flipping one arbitrary input mark, re-running the whole pour, and discarding the entire method if the new output resembles the old.
core_technique: xxHash-style hashing: eight parallel rotate-xor-multiply accumulator lanes over 64-byte blocks, position-weighted lane merge plus length injection, finalized by a splitmix64 xor-shift/multiply finalizer extended to seven steps.
